title: From Seed to Harvest: Augmenting Human Creativity with AI for Red-teaming Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Systematically substituting geographic references (e.g., countries, cities, regions) in seed prompts using LLMs to evaluate regional biases and cultural stereotypes in text-to-image generation.
Expanding seed prompts by substituting racial and ethnic demographic descriptors using LLMs and evaluating the generated images for stereotyping and hate using automated safety classifiers.

Modifying prompts to substitute religious descriptors and testing implicit adversarial prompts (e.g., 'Friday Prayers') to evaluate stereotyping and the exclusion of diverse faith communities in generated images.
Expanding seed prompts by systematically varying gender descriptors (e.g., 'woman', 'man', 'non-binary') using LLMs to test for gender-based representational harms and stereotypes.

Modifying prompts to include different socioeconomic, occupational, and educational indicators (e.g., 'working class', 'wealthy', 'uneducated') and evaluating the text-to-image models for discriminatory narratives.
Substituting age-related demographic descriptors (e.g., 'young adult', 'senior citizen') in red-teaming prompts to identify age-based stereotypes in image generation.
